exposure: rupture of membranes lasting more than 24 h
being referred from other health institutions
cohort: The study included 423 postpartum women (106 cases with puerperal sepsis and 317 controls) admitted to public hospitals in Harar town, Eastern Ethiopia.
finding: The study identified cesarean section delivery, rupture of membranes lasting more than 24 hours, labor duration exceeding 24 hours, undergoing more than 4 vaginal examinations, and being referred from other health institutions as independent determinants of puerperal sepsis.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was found to be a determinant of puerperal sepsis.
